problem.description: Independent Phase 7 review found mismatches between diagrams, BOMs, code examples, and hardware limits after ASCII replacement.
symptoms: D22-3 10k/20k UART divider can exceed ESP32 input limit under 5% tolerance
D09-1 polarized capacitor lacked polarity and open-switch state
D21 relay threshold lacked hysteresis and could chatter
D28 example had two preprocessor macros on one line and used ESP32 boot strap GPIO0 for a button
D24 Uno 5V to unspecified SD module had no level-shift qualification
D37 MQTT subscribe topic differed from publish topic
D51 and D53 examples referenced uninitialized or undefined sensor functions

hypotheses.description: Nominal-only divider analysis hid worst-case GPIO overvoltage
Figure generation and lesson text diverged after ASCII replacement
Some hands-on snippets were illustrative skeletons but presented as runnable
Unspecified board/module revisions prevent hardware sign-off

tests_run.command: Independent read-only source/geometry review by three agents
tests_run.output: P1/P2 findings localized to diagram IDs and adjacent hands-on text

findings: Automated image/mobile checks cannot prove net topology, electrical ratings, or code compilation.
Primary manufacturer references are linked in the corrected lessons; no physical board or module was supplied.

resolution.root_cause: Old lesson examples mixed nominal calculations, generic module assumptions and incomplete sketches; figure integration did not initially revalidate them against actual hardware limits.
resolution.fix_applied: Corrected known BOM/net/polarity/voltage/timing defects, aligned code and figures, and made uncertain relay/heater/sensor paths explicitly simulation-only or conditional on exact hardware review.
resolution.verification: Automated integration and viewport gates pass. Remaining hardware-specific and human technical review are tracked in P7-04/P7-06; this debug session remains active until those gates are satisfied.
